race.comment: TIGLETTA (3) only battled in when finishing sixth at Dubbo 11 days ago after settling well back in the field early on. She was heavily supported that day, and will have no fitness concerns third up from a spell. She can make amends in this. WRITTEN STORY (4) has been freshened up and changed stables since running the race of an improver when finishing third at Ballarat-synthetic just over 8 weeks ago. She will have no trouble measuring up in this easier company, and will be ready to rumble. Follow any market confidence. INYUN (5) ran on powerfully but too late when finishing fifth at Narromine just over a fortnight ago. The extra 100m, and the long run home here, will aid her chances and she can have the last say. RULE OF FAITH (1) needed her first run back from a spell, and her only win to date did come on this course. Include in all top 4 combos. TIYE (7) did not have all favours at Dubbo last start, and she can bounce straight back into the money here, despite the wide gate.
